notes.title: Music Update!
notes.content:
In honor of Frogmonster being out for 1 year Frogmonster has a new soundtrack! 

Featuring over 50 tracks including a theme for every boss in the game! 
It was a lot of fun contracting a community member to produce all of this music and bringing some more life to the game. Viho! did a great job.

Take a look at the trailer below and take a listen!

[previewyoutube=sH6RAKeOEB8;full][/previewyoutube]

The old one is still available just check classic soundtrack in settings

Other changes / fixes 
[list]
[*]General Audio balancing
[*]Some spelling and text fixes
[*]Setting for disabling BOW Fov zoom
[*]Bug fix with Runi crashing in Boss soup if you got close to him
[*]Fixed some arena soft locks with Djumbo and Xoto
[/list]

Thanks for 1 year of Frogmonster! This game has been so much fun to make and I'm grateful for the support.
The game will be on it's biggest sale yet for a week to celebrate starting in 2 hours! 
Tell a friend! 

Thanks 
Ben

notes.title: Boss Rush Soup - All Challenges now OUT!
notes.content:
The final challenge in Trenches Boss Rush Soup is OUT NOW! 
(I wonder who the boss could be ???)

After finishing the base game head to the Under City to go and visit Trench and see what he has cooking!

Each challenge has it's own surprise new boss at the end of it bringing the total number of bosses in Frogmonster to 32! It's been a blast creating all of these and I am proud of every one of them. Which one's have been your favorite?

Hope you enjoy and let me know what you think of the final soup! 

Also Bugfixes! 
- Weapon wheel now no longer moves camera when using
- Small performance improvements


Just want to take a moment to thank everyone who has played / shared my game. Being an indie dev is tough and spreading the word is the best way to help me out!

So just wanna say thanks!
-Ben

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3.2 - Flamethrower upgrade changes + Gatling gun changes + Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Just moved states so had to take a few weeks off for that but here's another patch adjusting some weapons and fixing bugs people have been experiencing.

Weapon Adjustments
[list]
[*] Flamethrower charge upgrade path has been changed! Instead of the old charge up and fire a ball you shoot a stream of liquid fire! Great for longer ranged and scales really well with bugs like the dragonfly!
[*] Piercing gatling gun upgrade route now has more ammo than before which should give it a better feel + a slight overall buff
[/list]

Quality of life improvements
[list]
[*]You can now bind keyboard bindings to num pad keys
[/list]

Bug Fixes 
[list]
[*]Fixes a bug where Runi fight could crash on the steamdeck
[*]Door crab boss bugfixes with the well boss version 
[*]Fixed a bug where runi could get stuck on a wall and softlock the fight
[*]Balsams eyes now go to dead when he dies 
[*]Myzand door crab variant fixed softlock issue 
[*]Fixed flamethrower issue with right hand loadouts (didn't fire towards center of screen)
[/list]

Thanks again everyone! 
I'll have some more news next week!
Ben

notes.title: Frogmonster has a New Demo For Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]MAJOR Changes: [/b]

[b]Face Groth a new boss! [/b]
	[list]
[*]You might find him in the swamp ;)
[/list]
[b]Use your tongue to catch critters you may find along your journey[/b]
[list]
[*]14 Critters have been added so far to the demo
[*]Adds to the audio and atmosphere of the game
[/list]
[b]Gun reworks all guns have been buffed and remodeled[/b]
[list]
[*]Bullet effects and improved bullet visability
[*]Bullet velocity has been increased substantially (about 2x)
[/list]
[b]Audio rework [/b]
[list]
[*]Added sound effects for a ton of stuff 
[*]New ambient environment sounds
[*]Hud sounds to assist the player
[/list]
[b]Graphics updates [/b]
[list]
[*]Updated particle affects for healing / mana drops 
[*]New High resolution option for powerful machines
[*}Reworked UI to improve performance
[/list]
[b]Gameplay updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Boss health is revealed when you die to them
[*]The Temple Beast has been reworked 	
[*]Drop coins on death mechanic added
[*]Health and mana upgrades in pieces	
[*]Some of the map has been redesigned 
[/list]
[b]Controller Support added [/b]
[list]
[*]If playing with a controller on pc is more your style you can now do so! 
[*]Mouse and keyboard is still the recommended way to play
[/list]
[b]Added save file slots and much more! Go try it out for yourself!!![/b]
